skills.board: Orchestrator: onboard, doctor, status, run and stop the board; runs the three lanes wave by wave.
skills.collect: Finds real problems in production and files verified, deduplicated Backlog cards.
skills.ui-refine-loop: Critique then refine one page or component until it looks right, with screenshots.
skills.visual: One self-contained HTML page: a branch recap, a plan, or a map of a folder.
skills.git-sync: Commit per logical change, merge-pull, push without force, report.

skills.build: Build lane: worktree, test first, smallest change, draft PR.
skills.qa: QA lane: evidence for each acceptance criterion, or bounce to Build.
skills.review: Review lane: reads the diff cold, approves one SHA, merges through the gate.
